assets.name: boulder
assets.prompt: Create one complete single-object concept for a 3D Jiangnan miniature farm game. Input 1 (bok choy) is only the approved painted material and rounded-form style reference; input 2 (farm) is only the approved world style reference. Do not depict vegetables or the scene. Object: exactly ONE asymmetrical broad river-bank limestone boulder, squat but substantial, a sloping uneven crown and 3 or 4 large interlocking rounded angular planes, a slightly chipped shoulder, one shallow natural diagonal seam, wider at its stable bottom. Broad substantial volume, NOT an egg, cube, sharp crystal, mountain or pile of loose stones. Width to height about 1.6:1, depth about 0.9 of width. Material is subdued cool warm-grey limestone with a slight sage cast, sparse muted moss-green pigment in crevices; finely painted selective contours and layered pale colour washes like the references, matte softly shaded real 3D volume. No photographic noisy microtexture, no glossy plastic, no heavy black outlines, no grass or separate plants. Weak-perspective three-quarter view from slightly above, show top front and side. Entire object and bottom visible, generous margin, plain off-white neutral background, soft neutral diffuse lighting and only faint contact shadow. No strong baked shadows, sunset, ground clump, pedestal, water, surrounding rocks, text, collage, labels, UI. High quality standalone modelling reference, square composition.
